title: PRD WS — Web search returns answers, not just titles
source_plan:
User reports: asking 'find the recipe for chili con carne' makes the assistant respond 'Found 5 results' without any actual recipe. Asking again ('give me the recipe') triggers a second web_search instead of using the first result. Three root causes:
  1) src/direct_tools.py _search_serper / _search_duckduckgo only emit `f"{title}: {url}"` — snippets are dropped on Serper and never extracted on DuckDuckGo.
  2) Both providers hardcode spoken={'en': 'Found N results. First: …'} which short-circuits whatever the generator could have said about the content.
  3) Even if snippets existed, src/context.py _format_recent_actions truncates each action's tail to 80 chars, so the generator can't read prior search content from action_log → forced to re-search.

Fix:
  - Include snippets in the result `output` for both providers.
  - Drop the hardcoded 'Found N results. First: …' spoken; replace with a short cue (e.g. 'Searching done.' / Ukrainian / Russian) so the generator chooses what to say from the content.
  - Optionally chain a single web_fetch of the top organic URL behind a new `web_search_fetch_top: bool = True` setting; append 'Top page content:' block to output. Failure-safe.
  - Bump action-log tail truncation to ~1500 chars for web_search/web_fetch entries (kept at 80 for everything else).
  - prompts/generator.txt: add an explicit rule ('If recent_actions contains a successful web_search/web_fetch on the topic, READ the snippets and answer — do NOT emit another web_search') with a positive example.
  - Update tests/test_direct_tools.py and tests/test_generator_prompt.py.
notes: Builds on PRD B (which introduced the spoken contract). Touches src/direct_tools.py, src/config.py (new setting), src/context.py (action-log truncation), prompts/generator.txt, tests/test_direct_tools.py, tests/test_generator_prompt.py. Does NOT change actions.py, conversation.py action-log storage, or main.py.

stories.title: Snippets in web_search output + drop hardcoded 'Found N results' spoken
stories.description: Modify _search_serper and _search_duckduckgo in src/direct_tools.py so each result string includes the snippet text. Format: ' <snippet> <url>' when snippet is present; '<title> <url>' otherwise. For Serper, use the existing data['organic'][i]['snippet'] field (currently read at line 397 but unused). For DuckDuckGo, extract <a class="result__snippet">…</a> (or the more common <a class="result__snippet" href=...>text</a> / <td class="result-snippet">text</td>) text adjacent to each result__a link. Use a robust regex that pairs the title link with its snippet (or returns the title-only result if no snippet found nearby). Drop the hardcoded 'Found N results. First: …' spoken text from both providers. Replace with a minimal language-neutral cue: spoken={'en':'Searching done.','uk':'Пошук завершено.','ru':'Поиск завершён.'} on success-with-results; keep the existing 'No results found.' on zero hits and 'Search failed.' on error. The generator (which sees the snippets via the action log) will compose the actual content-aware answer.
acceptanceCriteria:
_search_serper: each non-empty entry in `output` is formatted '<title>
<snippet>
<url>' when the Serper organic record has a non-empty 'snippet'; otherwise '<title>
<url>'. Knowledge graph result still appears first as '📚 …' with description preserved.

_search_duckduckgo: each entry is '<title>
<snippet>
<url>' when a snippet element is present in the HTML for that result, else '<title>
<url>'. Snippet extraction handles the 'result__snippet' DuckDuckGo class.

Both providers replace the hardcoded 'Found N results. First: …' spoken with spoken={'en':'Searching done.','uk':'Пошук завершено.','ru':'Поиск завершён.'} on the success-with-results path. Zero-results spoken stays 'No results found.' / Ukrainian / Russian. Error spoken stays 'Search failed.' / Ukrainian / Russian.

Add a fresh test test_web_search_serper_includes_snippets that mocks Serper response with snippets and asserts both title and snippet are in output.

stories.title: Optional chained web_fetch of top result behind web_search_fetch_top setting
stories.description: Add a new field `web_search_fetch_top: bool = True` to src/config.Settings (next to web_search_provider). When True AND the search produced at least one organic result with a URL, _execute_web_search performs a single chained web_fetch on the top URL and appends the fetched (truncated) content as a 'Top page content:' block to the output string. Use the existing _execute_web_fetch helper for parity (HTML->text trimming, length cap). Fetch failure must be swallowed silently — the search result remains successful and the snippets-only output is returned without the appended block. Total output is hard-capped at 8000 chars to protect downstream prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: src/config.py Settings has new field `web_search_fetch_top: bool = True`, documented one line above (e.g. '# Auto-fetch the top organic search result so the agent has full content for content-style queries (recipe, how-to). Disable to save bandwidth.').

src/direct_tools.py _execute_web_search: after the search succeeds and a top URL is available, when settings.web_search_fetch_top is True, call _execute_web_fetch(top_url, settings) and append '

Top page content:
<fetched_text>' to output. If web_fetch fails (success=False or raises), swallow and return the snippets-only output unchanged.
Total output length is capped at 8000 chars (truncate with '\n... (truncated)' suffix if exceeded).
When settings is None OR settings.web_search_fetch_top is False, no chained fetch happens (regression-safe path for callers that don't pass settings).

tests/test_direct_tools.py: add test_web_search_chains_web_fetch_when_enabled that mocks both Serper-or-DDG and the subsequent web_fetch (use module-level patches), asserts the appended 'Top page content:' block appears in output.

tests/test_direct_tools.py: add test_web_search_skips_fetch_when_disabled that sets settings.web_search_fetch_top=False and verifies no web_fetch call was made AND no 'Top page content:' block in output.

tests/test_direct_tools.py: add test_web_search_swallows_top_fetch_error that makes web_fetch fail; assert search result is still success=True and output contains the snippets but no 'Top page content:' block.
tests/test_direct_tools.py: existing test_web_search_duckduckgo_success continues to pass (it passes settings=None so no fetch happens).

stories.title: Action log preserves web_search/web_fetch content (bump tail truncation)
stories.description: src/context.ContextBuilder._format_recent_actions currently truncates every action's tail (result/error/args) to 80 chars (line 230). For web_search and web_fetch entries that's far too short — the generator never sees the snippets and is forced to re-search. Bump the tail cap to 1500 chars when tool == 'web_search' or 'web_fetch'; keep 80 chars for everything else (so list_profiles tables and bash output don't bloat the prompt).
acceptanceCriteria: src/context.py _format_recent_actions branches the truncation length on entry['tool']: 1500 chars for {'web_search', 'web_fetch'}, 80 chars otherwise.

tests/test_context.py: add test_format_recent_actions_keeps_web_search_content asserting that a 1000-char result string for tool='web_search' appears intact in the formatted line (no '... (truncated)' marker, length > 80).
tests/test_context.py: add test_format_recent_actions_truncates_other_tools asserting that a 200-char bash result is still truncated to 80 chars.

stories.title: Generator prompt: read prior search results, do not re-search
stories.description:
Edit prompts/generator.txt. Add a rule (under or extending the 'Conversation context' / 'Use this context …' block) and at least one positive example showing the generator answering from a prior web_search result instead of emitting another <intent>{'tool':'web_search',…}</intent>.

Rule wording target: 'If `recent_actions` contains a successful web_search or web_fetch whose query/URL matches the user's current question, READ the result text and answer from it. Do NOT emit another web_search/web_fetch intent for the same topic.'

Example to add: user asks about a recipe after a prior web_search done; generator dictates the recipe steps from the snippets/top content rather than re-searching.
acceptanceCriteria: prompts/generator.txt contains a rule line referencing recent_actions and explicitly forbidding re-emitting web_search/web_fetch when the same topic was already searched. Phrase MUST include both 'recent_actions' and at least one of 'do not' / 'don\'t' / 'avoid'.

prompts/generator.txt contains at least one new positive example where the user follow-up ('give me the recipe' / 'дай рецепт' / 'дай рецепт') is answered from prior search content WITHOUT a new <intent> tag.

tests/test_generator_prompt.py: add test_template_has_use_prior_search_rule asserting the rule line is present (substring match for 'recent_actions' AND ('do not' or 'don\'t' or 'avoid') AND ('web_search' or 'search')).

tests/test_generator_prompt.py: add test_template_has_prior_search_followup_example asserting at least one example block describes a follow-up like 'give me the recipe' (or Ukrainian/Russian equivalent) followed by an answer that does NOT contain a `<intent>{\"tool\":\"web_search\"` tag for the same topic in that example block.
tests/test_generator_prompt.py: existing test_template_has_exactly_expected_placeholders MUST stay green (no new placeholders introduced).
